product_overview: A Telegram bot that transforms raw product ideas into structured, traceable product specifications and supports the full engineering lifecycle: design, decomposition, test generation, architecture, code generation, build assembly, and Git export.

general_info.name: Product Management
general_info.overview: CRUD operations for Product — the root entity of the system.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Allow users to create and manage products as the root context for all downstream artifacts.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need a structured way to define products before creating features, stories, and other artifacts.

business_rules.description: Product must exist before any child entity is created.
Product default status is draft.
Every Product must be versioned (version >= 1).
Approval is version-bound. Changing content invalidates approval.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create a product so that I can start defining features.

bdd.when: The user sends product data (name, description, goal)
bdd.then: A new product is created in draft status with version 1

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to edit a product so that I can refine its definition.

bdd.then: The product is updated, version is incremented, approval is invalidated if previously approved

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to approve a product so downstream generation can proceed.

bdd.given: A product exists in reviewed status
bdd.then: Status changes to approved, approved_version is set to current version

non_functional_requirements.description: All products must be traceable by ID.

test_cases.assertion: 201 Created, product returned with draft status and version 1
200 OK, status is approved, approved_version set

general_info.name: Feature Management
general_info.overview: CRUD for Features — primary decomposition unit of product scope.

goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need to break down a product into features that can be independently specified.

business_rules.description: Feature belongs to exactly one Product.
Physical deletion allowed only for unreferenced draft features.
Feature has code, name, priority, sort_order.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create a feature under a product.

bdd.when: The user creates a feature with name and product_id
bdd.then: Feature is created in draft status linked to the product

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to delete an unreferenced draft feature.

bdd.given: A draft feature exists with no downstream references

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to be prevented from deleting a referenced feature.

bdd.when: The user tries to delete the feature
bdd.then: Deletion is rejected with an error

general_info.name: Actor Management
general_info.overview: CRUD for Actors and Feature-Actor linking.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Define actors at product level and link them to features.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need to manage actors and link them to features for story creation.

business_rules.description: Actor belongs to exactly one Product.
Feature may link to one or more Actors via FeatureActorLink.
Actor may be reused across multiple Features within the same Product.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create an actor for a product.

bdd.when: The user creates an actor with name and role_type
bdd.then: Actor is created linked to the product

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to link an actor to a feature.

bdd.given: A product, feature, and actor exist
bdd.when: The user links the actor to the feature

general_info.name: User Story Management
general_info.overview: CRUD for User Stories with actor assignment and approval workflow.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Capture user needs as structured stories.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need to write stories in canonical format (As/I want/So that) and link them to actors.

business_rules.description: Story belongs to exactly one Feature.
Story references exactly one Actor.
Story Actor must be linked to the Story's Feature via FeatureActorLink.
Story cannot move downstream until Actor is assigned and Story is approved.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create a user story for a feature.

bdd.given: A feature and actor exist, actor is linked to feature
bdd.when: The user creates a story with actor_id, want_text, benefit_text
bdd.then: Story is created in draft status
and_postconditions: actor_id is validated against feature actor links

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to be prevented from creating a story with an unlinked actor.

bdd.given: A feature and actor exist but actor is NOT linked to feature
bdd.when: The user creates a story with that actor_id
bdd.then: Creation is rejected with validation error

test_cases.setup: Feature, actor exist but no link

general_info.name: User Flow Management
general_info.overview: CRUD for User Flows stored in Mermaid format.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Visualize user journeys as Mermaid diagrams.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need to create and approve flows before generating use cases.

business_rules.description: User Flow belongs to exactly one Story.
One Story must support exactly one primary Flow.
All User Flows must contain Mermaid source.
Flow must be approved before Use Case generation.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create a primary flow for a story with Mermaid source.

bdd.when: The user creates a flow with flow_type=primary and mermaid_source
bdd.then: Flow is created in draft status

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to be prevented from creating a second primary flow.

bdd.given: A story already has a primary flow
bdd.when: The user creates another primary flow for the same story

general_info.name: Use Case Management
general_info.overview: CRUD for Use Cases derived from approved Flows.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Capture structured behavioral specifications from flows.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need use cases with Given/When/Then format before generating requirements.

business_rules.description: Use Case belongs to exactly one User Flow.
Requirement generation must not proceed from a non-approved Use Case.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create a use case from an approved flow.

bdd.when: The user creates a use case with given/when/then and scenarios
bdd.then: Use case is created in draft status

general_info.name: Requirement Management
general_info.overview: CRUD for Requirements derived from approved Use Cases.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Define formal requirements traceable to use cases.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need explicit requirements with type classification before engineering work.

business_rules.description: Requirement must have at least one upstream traceable source.
requirement_type must explicitly classify the requirement (functional, non_functional, etc.).
At least one approved Requirement must exist before downstream decomposition begins.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to create a requirement from an approved use case.

bdd.when: The user creates a requirement with type and text
bdd.then: Requirement is created in draft status with upstream traceability

general_info.name: Approval Workflow
general_info.overview: Universal approval/rejection workflow for all approvable entities.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Gate downstream generation with explicit approval.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need to review and approve artifacts before they can be used downstream.

business_rules.description: Approval is version-bound. approved_version = current version.
Content change invalidates prior approval automatically.
Downstream generation allowed only from approved artifacts.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to approve an entity so it can be used downstream.

bdd.then: Status becomes approved, approved_version is set

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, when I edit an approved entity, its approval should be invalidated.

bdd.when: The user edits the entity content
bdd.then: Version increments, status changes to changed, approval is cleared

general_info.name: Specification Health Dashboard
general_info.overview: Health checks for specification completeness at Product and Feature levels.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Give users visibility into spec gaps and issues.
goal_and_context.user_problem: Users need to know which features lack stories, which stories lack flows, etc.

business_rules.description: Health checks detect: features without approved stories, stories without actors, stories without primary flows, approved flows without use cases, approved use cases without requirements, approved requirements without test designs, tasks without linked tests, tasks without context packages.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a Product Owner, I want to see a health summary of my product specification.

bdd.given: A product with features, stories, flows exists
bdd.when: The user requests the health dashboard
bdd.then: A report is returned listing all spec gaps
